summary: P0 Follow-up Email CTA Fixes - All 4 issues verified and working correctly. Reschedule CTA shows date/time picker form, Close CTA displays scheduled date/time, Logo uses 64px, CTA status tracked in history.
seed_data_creation: Created test follow-ups for CTA testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 CTA fixes verified. All 4 issues resolved: 1) GET /api/follow-ups/{id}/client-action?action=reschedule returns HTML form with date picker, time picker, and submit button (not instant confirmation). 2) GET /api/follow-ups/{id}/client-action?action=close returns HTML with 'Scheduled Follow-up' section showing formatted date/time. 3) Logo uses max-height: 64px in email template (line 703), action page (line 971), and reschedule page (line 1018). 4) POST /api/follow-ups/{id}/client-reschedule correctly updates client_response, client_preferred_date, client_preferred_time fields and adds history entry with action=client_reschedule. FollowUpsTable CLIENT column shows 'Confirmed' for client_closed and 'Reschedule' for client_reschedule actions. History section in detail dialog shows client action entries with 'Client (via email)' attribution.

p0_fixes_verified.issue: 1. Reschedule CTA must show date/time picker form (not instant confirmation)
p0_fixes_verified.verification: GET /api/follow-ups/{id}/client-action?action=reschedule returns HTML with <form>, type='date', type='time', preferred_date, preferred_time fields, and 'Request Reschedule' submit button. Does NOT show 'Reschedule Requested' instant confirmation.

p0_fixes_verified.issue: 2. Close confirmation page must display scheduled date/time
p0_fixes_verified.verification: GET /api/follow-ups/{id}/client-action?action=close returns HTML with 'Confirmed!' title and 'Scheduled Follow-up' section showing formatted date (e.g., 'Wednesday, January 28, 2026 at 02:00 PM')

p0_fixes_verified.issue: 3. Email logo must be larger (64px instead of 48-52px)
p0_fixes_verified.verification: All 3 logo references in follow_ups.py use max-height: 64px - email template (line 703), action page (line 971), reschedule page (line 1018). No 48px or 52px references found.

p0_fixes_verified.issue: 4. CTA status must be correctly tracked in follow-up history
p0_fixes_verified.verification: POST /api/follow-ups/{id}/client-reschedule sets client_response, client_preferred_date, client_preferred_time fields and adds history entry with action='client_reschedule', by='Client (via email)'. GET /api/follow-ups/{id}/client-action?action=close adds history entry with action='client_closed'.
